prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: pale pink-white coral sand with shell fragments and small coral pieces The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square, seamless repeatable tile texture for a top-down JRPG map: pale pink-white coral sand with scattered tiny shell fragments and small coral chips, distributed evenly over the ENTIRE image, no focal point. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, hand-placed pixel clusters of 3–10 uniform crisp square art pixels. Render as approximately 256 by 256 art pixels, enlarged with nearest-neighbor to display size; every pixel square is same size. Sand has 4–6 earthy hues with warm pale yellow-cream highlights and slightly saturated mauve-purple/red shadow accents. Shell flecks and coral bits are small, recognizable pixel-cluster shapes but subtle and well dispersed. Orthographic straight-down game ground tile, neutral soft even upper-left illumination, clean base colors, no cast shadows. CRITICAL: texture wraps perfectly: shapes and colors along left boundary continue at right boundary, and top continues at bottom. Surface fills full bleed edge-to-edge. No borders, frames, text, characters, objects, large features, lighting effects, glow, vignette, antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, photographic noise or checkerboard dithering.
